## 1. Scope & Privacy Commitment

Urban Craft & Co. ("we", "our", or "us") respects the privacy of every visitor, corporate client, and business partner. We operate an enquiry-first platform designed to minimize unnecessary data capture.

This Privacy Policy describes the categories of data we collect, why we collect it, how it is processed, with whom it is shared, and how you can exercise control over your personal data in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000, and applicable Indian data protection principles.

## 2. Information We Collect

We collect only information that you voluntarily submit to us or that is technically necessary to facilitate your enquiry and ensure website integrity:

- **Contact & Professional Identity:** Full name, corporate email address, mobile/WhatsApp telephone number, company or organization name, job designation, and office location.
- **Gifting Project Specifications:** Target recipient group, estimated quantities, target delivery deadlines, budget guidelines, and preferred product categories.
- **Branding Assets & Custom Artwork:** Vector logo files (AI, EPS, SVG, PDF), brand identity guidelines, typography preferences, colour codes (Pantone/CMYK), and recipient name lists supplied for personalized laser engraving or printing.
- **Essential Browser Storage:** To provide a seamless user experience, our website uses client-side browser storage (such as `LocalStorage` and `SessionStorage`) on your own device. This securely stores your product shortlist ("Favourites") and preserves active multi-step enquiry drafts across browser refreshes. This data remains on your device until you submit the enquiry form or clear your browser cache.
- **Technical Log Data:** When you access our website, standard web server infrastructure logs basic technical metadata (such as IP address, browser type and version, device category, referring URL, and server request timestamps). These logs are used strictly for website maintenance, capacity planning, and security audits.

## 3. Purpose of Data Processing

We process the information you share exclusively for lawful commercial purposes:

- **Enquiry Assessment & Proposal Preparation:** To review your gifting brief, verify product availability, formulate pricing structures, and issue formal commercial quotations.
- **Design & Pre-Production Proofing:** To generate visual mockups, 2D/3D artwork placements, and custom branding proofs for client sign-off.
- **Order Execution & Assembly:** To procure inventory, configure customized packaging, and oversee production quality.
- **Pan-India Logistics & Dispatch Coordination:** To generate shipping labels, coordinate freight pickups, share consignment tracking dockets, and ensure accurate physical delivery.
- **Tax & Statutory Accounting:** To issue official GST tax invoices, record banking remittances, reconcile accounts, and comply with Indian statutory audit mandates.
- **Spam & Threat Mitigation:** To protect our enquiry forms against automated bots, distributed attacks, and fraudulent requests.

## 4. Explicit Non-Sale of Data

We do **not** sell, rent, monetize, or lease your personal or corporate data to advertising networks, marketing intermediaries, or third-party data brokers. Your contact details are used strictly in connection with your business relationship with Urban Craft & Co.

## 5. Lawful & Operational Information Sharing

To deliver our corporate gifting services, we may share relevant data on a strictly confidential, need-to-know basis with trusted operational partners:

- **Logistics & Courier Partners:** We share consignee names, delivery addresses, and contact phone numbers with reputable express courier companies and commercial freight transporters to facilitate delivery and SMS/tracking updates.
- **Specialized Branding Workshops:** Where proprietary branding processes (such as precision laser engraving, deep foil embossing, or textile embroidery) are performed by contracted specialists, approved artwork files and placement dimensions are shared strictly for production execution.
- **Statutory & Professional Advisers:** Transactional, billing, and payment records may be reviewed by our certified chartered accountants, tax auditors, or legal advisors to satisfy Indian statutory compliance.
- **Legal & Regulatory Authorities:** We may disclose information where mandated by law, court summons, government investigation, or regulatory decree, or to enforce our legal rights and defend against claims.

## 6. Security Safeguards & Realistic Expectations

We implement commercially reasonable administrative, procedural, and technical safeguards to shield client information from unauthorized access, accidental alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Access to client briefs and proprietary corporate artwork is restricted to personnel directly engaged in order fulfillment.

However, please recognize that no system of electronic transmission or cloud storage is entirely impenetrable. While we take diligent precautions, we cannot guarantee absolute security against sophisticated cyber incidents beyond our reasonable control.

## 7. Data Retention & Storage Protocols

We retain enquiry submissions, commercial correspondence, and design files only for as long as necessary to fulfill commercial commitments, maintain customer relationship histories, and satisfy Indian statutory requirements:

- **Enquiries Without Orders:** Enquiries that do not convert into confirmed orders are routinely archived or deleted after reasonable follow-up periods.
- **Confirmed Orders & Tax Records:** Invoices, delivery receipts, and accounting ledgers are retained for a minimum of 8 years in strict accordance with the Goods and Services Tax (GST) Act, Income Tax Act, and Indian corporate record-keeping mandates.
- **Branding Artwork:** We retain approved vector files to streamline seamless re-orders for returning corporate clients, unless you request their deletion.

## 8. Your Rights & Choices

As a valued client, you have clear rights regarding the data we hold:

- **Access & Review:** You may request a summary of the contact information or business details we hold on record.
- **Correction & Updating:** You may notify us at any time to rectify outdated, inaccurate, or incomplete contact details.
- **Marketing Opt-Out:** If you receive periodic product catalogs or festive gifting bulletins from us, you can opt out at any time by replying with "Unsubscribe" or contacting our privacy desk.
- **Data Deletion:** You may request the deletion of your enquiry data, subject to our legal obligation to preserve records required for taxation, statutory audit, or contractual dispute defense.

## 9. Third-Party Integrations & External Links

Our website incorporates external service links to facilitate communication, including direct WhatsApp chat support and embedded Google Maps for location guidance. These services operate under their own respective privacy statements. We encourage you to review their policies when interacting with third-party platforms.

## 10. Updates to This Policy

We may revise this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect enhancements in our data management practices or changes in applicable Indian statutes. Any revisions will be published on this page with an updated "Last Updated" date.
